summary: Harmonic Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the completion of the sale of its Video Business to Leone Media Inc. (d/b/a MediaKind) for $145 million in cash. The purchase price is subject to customary working capital, cash, indebtedness, and selling expense adjustments. The Asset Purchase Agreement, dated March 20, 2026, includes a three-year non-compete and reciprocal indemnification. Neven Haltmayer, SVP and GM of the Video Business, resigned upon closing. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Pro forma financials were omitted as the business was previously reported as discontinued operations. What to watch: integration execution by MediaKind and Harmonic's post-divestiture strategy; risk-arb is limited as the deal is closed.
